axes.name: decl
axes.rationale: Declaration order sets the frame slots; original has slot at [bp-4], handles segment at [bp-6], count at [bp-0xa]

axes.name: cond
axes.rationale: Embedded assignment in the condition tests the loaded value from AX

spec.semantic_summary: Batch: count assigned inside the guard condition or before it, x declaration orders giving the 18-byte frame (slot, handles, count, n, table)
